name: m-stage-steps

fields.name: stage
fields.description: The research stage the step belongs to, from the stages the paper's own system carries out or supports: literature-review, ideation-hypothesis, experiment-design, implementation-execution, data-analysis, paper-writing, review-verification, lab-automation, other. Row key with step_order. The quote is the sentence that shows the step belongs to this stage.

fields.name: step_order
fields.description: Row key with stage: the position of this step within its stage in the paper's own account, 1 for the first. One row per step, never two rows with the same stage and number. The quote is the sentence that introduces or describes the step.

fields.name: step
fields.description: The paper's own words for what the step does, copied exactly (one clause or sentence).

fields.name: inputs
fields.description: A sentence that says what the step takes in (documents, a hypothesis, code, data). Omit when the paper does not say.

fields.name: outputs
fields.description: A sentence that says what the step produces. Omit when the paper does not say.

fields.name: method
fields.description: A sentence that says how the step is done: the technique, tool, prompt design or model used. Omit when the paper does not say.

fields.name: actor
fields.description: Who carries out the step as the paper describes it: automated (the system alone), human-assisted (a person reviews, approves or steers), human, not-stated.

fields.name: check
fields.description: A sentence that says how the paper validates or checks the result of this step (a verifier, a reviewer, a test, a human check). Omit when the paper does not say.

fields.name: limits
fields.description: A sentence in which the paper says what goes wrong or is limited in this step (a failure mode, an error rate, a stated limitation). Omit when the paper does not say.

rationale: v1 (2026-11-14; plan 2026-11-13-lifecycle-stage-deep-dive): the steps inside each research stage of an AI research system as the paper describes them, with inputs, outputs, method, actor, how the step is checked and what limits it; whole text; core works; stage axis is the 9 stages of m-stages v1. EXPLORATORY: no calibration, for reading, not evidence. A paper that describes no steps is closed with no rows and a reason.
